# Konstantinos Lianos

> Angular modernization and performance consultant based in Vouliagmeni, Attiki, Greece. Software architect with over a decade
> architecting, optimizing, and modernizing large-scale web applications. Takes contract work for teams worldwide, including the EU, UK,
> and US, through Quokka L.P.

## Current work

Runs Quokka L.P., and is available for contract work through it. Always open to talking about new opportunities: if his own time
is committed to another client, a colleague from his team at Quokka takes on the work, with his supervision and support.

Senior Frontend Software Engineer at Vimachem (IIoT Pharma 4.0 AI Platform), Athens — since March 2026.

## What he does

- **Architecture and optimization** — scalable, high-performance web applications tailored to business needs.
- **Rapid modernization** — migrating and upgrading legacy systems with minimal downtime.
- **Performance tuning** — lazy loading, IndexedDB caching, and advanced data manipulation for responsive interfaces.
- **Team enablement** — training, mentoring, hiring, and instilling engineering standards.

## Selected achievements

- Led the Angular modernization of a critical EU regulatory platform, upgrading from
  Angular 6 to 21, introducing Nrwl Nx with tags and module boundaries, and migrating the test suite from Protractor and
  Karma/Jasmine to WebdriverIO and Jest.
- Migrated an entire UI codebase from dozens of separate repositories to a single Nx monorepo, and set up its CI pipeline with
  unit tests, linting rules, and incremental builds.
- Reduced load times substantially for a massive dynamically generated form driven by backend JSON configuration, via lazy loading
  of all controls plus graph manipulation and IndexedDB caching strategies.
- Designed frontend architectures for multiple organizations, transitioning systems from Java-based stacks to modern JavaScript
  frameworks.
- Built, as sole developer, a web application that remains in use and earned an official thanks from a national chief of staff.

## Technologies

Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Nrwl Nx, Jest, WebdriverIO, Spring MVC, Agile (Scrum/Kanban), Jenkins CI/CD.
